exact_statement: Let h be the six-bit uniform sign negative on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}. For every nonconstant six-bit Boolean core g with E(g)=min_relevant_i B_i(g)/Inf_i(g)>=14/5, there is a single output orientation sigma in {-1,1} such that for six disjoint identical copies F=h((sigma*g)_1,...,(sigma*g)_6), every relevant physical coordinate satisfies B_(j,i)(F)/Inf_(j,i)(F)>=B_i(g)/Inf_i(g), hence E(F)>=E(g). Orient g0 to at most 32 negative points M, then sigma*g=g0 except use -g0 for 16<=M<=20. This is proved by all 559 exact signature certificates plus complete 23-orbit sparse-core certificates E<14/5 when M<=3, with the signed recentered formula rederived in the report. No arbitrary-dimension or all-depth admission is asserted.
